reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Support for L7 protocol visibility using Pod annotations (`policy.cilium.io/proxy-visibility`), deprecated since v1.15, has been removed", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: Pod annotations using policy.cilium.io/proxy-visibility will no longer be honored and L7 protocol visibility configuration via this annotation will be ignored.

proposed.statement: Pod annotation policy.cilium.io/proxy-visibility, deprecated since v1.15, has been removed in Cilium 1.17.0.
